"import pygame
import random
import sys

# --- Инициализация ---
pygame.init ( )

# --- Константы ---
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 800, 600
FPS = 60
PLAYER_BASE_SPEED = 3
ROVER_SPEED = 5
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
BLACK = (0, 0, 0)
MOON_GRAY = (40, 40, 50)

# --- Настройка экрана ---
screen = pygame.display.set_mode (  ( WIDTH, HEIGHT ) )
pygame.display.set_caption ( \"Lunar Recycler\")
clock = pygame.time.Clock ( )
font = pygame.font.Font ( None, 36)

# --- Игровые классы ---

class Player ( pygame.sprite.Sprite ) :
    def __init__ ( self ) :
        super (  ) .__init__ ( )
        self.image = pygame.Surface (  ( 40, 40 ) )
        self.image.fill (  ( 100, 200, 255 ) ) # Голубой робот
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect ( center= ( WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2 ) )
        self.speed = PLAYER_BASE_SPEED
        self.capacity = 10
        self.inventory = 0
        self.money = 0
        self.has_rover = False
        self.has_truck = False

    def update ( self ) :
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed ( )
        dx, dy = 0, 0
        
        # Скорость зависит от купленного транспорта
        current_speed = self.speed
        if self.has_rover:
            current_speed = ROVER_SPEED

        if keys[pygame.K_w]: dy = -current_speed
        if keys[pygame.K_s]: dy = current_speed
        if keys[pygame.K_a]: dx = -current_speed
        if keys[pygame.K_d]: dx = current_speed

        self.rect.x += dx
        self.rect.y += dy

        # Ограничение границами экрана
        self.rect.clamp_ip ( screen.get_rect (  ) )

    def collect_trash ( self ) :
        if self.inventory < self.capacity:
            self.inventory += 1
            self.money += 10
            trash_sprites.remove ( trash_collected[0])
            trash_group.add ( LunarTrash (  ) )

    def open_shop ( self ) :
        shop_open = True
        while shop_open:
            screen.fill ( BLACK)
            title = font.render ( \"МАГАЗИН (E - закрыть ) \", True, WHITE)
            rover_text = f\"1. Ровер (+скорость) - 100$\", True, WHITE
            truck_text = f\"2. Грузовик (+вместимость) - 200$\", True, WHITE
            
            screen.blit ( title, (WIDTH // 2 - title.get_width ( ) // 2, 50 ) )
            screen.blit ( font.render ( rover_text[0], True, (200, 200, 0) if self.money >= 100 else (100, 100, 100 )  ) , (250, 200 ) )
            screen.blit ( font.render ( truck_text[0], True, (200, 200, 0) if self.money >= 200 else (100, 100, 100 )  ) , (250, 250 ) )
            
            info = font.render ( f\"Деньги: {self.money}$\", True, WHITE)
            screen.blit ( info, (20, 20 ) )
            pygame.display.flip ( )

            for event in pygame.event.get (  ) :
                if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                    pygame.quit ( )
                    sys.exit ( )
                if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                    if event.key == pygame.K_e:
                        shop_open = False
                    if event.key == pygame.K_1 and self.money >= 100 and not self.has_rover:
                        self.money -= 100
                        self.has_rover = True
                        self.speed = ROVER_SPEED
                    if event.key == pygame.K_2 and self.money >= 200 and not self.has_truck:
                        self.money -= 200
                        self.has_truck = True
                        self.capacity += 20

class LunarTrash ( pygame.sprite.Sprite ) :
    def __init__ ( self ) :
        super (  ) .__init__ ( )
        self.image = pygame.Surface (  ( 20, 20 ) )
        self.image.fill (  ( 0, 100, 255 ) ) # Синий мусор
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(
            center= ( random.randint ( 20, WIDTH-20 ) , random.randint ( 20, HEIGHT-20 ) )
        )

class Monster ( pygame.sprite.Sprite ) :
    def __init__ ( self ) :
        super (  ) .__init__ ( )
        self.image = pygame.Surface (  ( 50, 50 ) )
        self.image.fill (  ( 255, 50, 50 ) ) # Красный монстр
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(
            center= ( random.randint ( 50, WIDTH-50 ) , random.randint ( 50, HEIGHT-50 ) )
        )
        self.speed = 2

    def update ( self, player_pos ) :
        # Простейший ИИ: монстр идет к игроку
        dx = player_pos[0] - self.rect.centerx
        dy = player_pos[1] - self.rect.centery
        dist = (dx**2 + dy**2 ) **0.5
        
        if dist > 0:
            dx = int ( dx / dist * self.speed)
            dy = int ( dy / dist * self.speed)
        
        self.rect.x += dx
        self.rect.y += dy
        
        # Если монстр поймал игрока
        if self.rect.colliderect ( player_pos ) :
            # Отнимает 5 единиц мусора (но не меньше 0)
            player.inventory = max ( 0, player.inventory - 5)
            # Телепортирует монстра в случайное место
            self.rect.center = (random.randint ( 50, WIDTH-50 ) , random.randint ( 50, HEIGHT-50 ) )

# --- Создание групп спрайтов ---
player = Player ( )
all_sprites = pygame.sprite.Group ( player)
trash_group = pygame.sprite.Group ( )
monster_group = pygame.sprite.Group ( )

# Создаем 15 единиц мусора
for _ in range ( 15 ) :
    t = LunarTrash ( )
    trash_group.add ( t)
    all_sprites.add ( t)

# Создаем монстра
monster = Monster ( )
monster_group.add ( monster)
all_sprites.add ( monster)

# --- Игровой цикл ---
running = True
while running:
    clock.tick ( FPS)
    
    for event in pygame.event.get (  ) :
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key == pygame.K_e:
                player.open_shop ( )

    # Обновление
    all_sprites.update ( player.rect)
    
    # Проверка сбора мусора
    trash_collected = pygame.sprite.spritecollide ( player, trash_group, False)
    if trash_collected:
        player.collect_trash ( )

    # --- Отрисовка ---
    screen.fill ( MOON_GRAY) # Фон Луны
    
    # Рисуем все спрайты
    all_sprites.draw ( screen)
    
    # Интерфейс (HUD)
    money_text = font.render ( f\"Деньги: {player.money}$\", True, WHITE)
    inv_text = font.render ( f\"Инвентарь: {player.inventory}/{player.capacity}\", True, WHITE)
    hint_text = font.render ( \"WASD - ехать | E - Магазин\", True, (150, 150, 150 ) )
    
    screen.blit ( money_text, (20, 20 ) )
    screen.blit ( inv_text, (20, 60 ) )
    screen.blit ( hint_text, (20, HEIGHT - 40 ) )

    pygame.display.flip ( )

pygame.quit (  )

---

"
